summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public preview for header order + glass overlay + responsive/interaction checks. All pytest regression suites passed (170/170). Browser automation validated desktop order, overlay CSS, geometry, click/drag/keyboard/history, and touch 14px commit; touch 8px cancel showed inconsistent behavior under CDP emulation.

integration_issues.flow: Touch short-drag cancel on language switch (390px, CDP touch emulation)
integration_issues.issue: 8px touch drag from EN sometimes navigates EN->TR instead of cancel/snap-back.
integration_issues.follow_up_status: Not reproduced by main-agent traced tests or12/12 repeat trials; original observation retained for provenance. No gesture-code change made.

action_items: User visual approval of overlay and desktop placement.

If a physical-device short-drag issue is later reported, capture actual pointer coordinates and viewport scaling before changing gesture semantics; main-agent follow-up did not reproduce the initial CDP observation.
critical_code_review_comments: Desktop header order confirmed: register -> icon-links -> lang-switch in DOM and visual order.
Overlay styling confirmed: .lang-rail::before blur(.35px), pointer-events none, z-index 0; knob z-index 1 with opaque rgb(236,236,236) and no backdrop blur.
Responsive checkpoints 320/390/768/769/800/900/1024/1440/1920 showed expected rail/knob sizes (48x26/24 and 32x20/18) with no horizontal overflow.
Maintainability: /app/frontend/css/styles.css remains very large (>700 lines); modular split recommended later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright run verified desktop order/focus, overlay CSS, click navigation, pointer drag hold/release (no nav until release), keyboard ArrowRight, reduced-motion sampling, and CDP touch 14px commit pass. CDP touch 8px cancel was inconsistent (navigated). Full pytest regression pass: 170/170 with new durable test file.
rca of the issue: Initial unconfirmed hypothesis: touch-threshold/CDP dispatch or coordinate scaling. Follow-up traces showed correct8px pointer movement and suppressed synthetic click in all reproduced modes. No product root cause confirmed and no functional code changed.

main_agent_follow_up.traces: Three modes at390x844: one fast move, one held move, stepped moves. All EN8px drags remained EN; trace showed pointerdown343->pointermove335->pointerup335->syntheticclick suppressed.
main_agent_follow_up.repeat_trials: 12/12 short8px touch snapbacks passed across EN and TR with0/15/40ms delays.14px hold produced no navigation until release, then correct TR->EN navigation.
main_agent_follow_up.current_status: Requested appearance/placement verified; no failing flow observed in follow-up. User review pending.
